race.comment: THE SHERIFF (15) has more to prove after weakening as favourite at Cranbourne, but the Damian Lane booking and the Mick Price & Michael Kent Jnr stable profile keep him firmly in the winning discussion, expect quick improvement. WEASEL SEA (7) is hard to fault for consistency, with seven placings from eight starts and another close fourth at Mornington. Sets a good standard again. BEMM RIVER (2) resumes off a Moe trial win and has twice gone very close at Sale, can pick up where he left off from a good gate. WYANDRA (8) checked and unbalanced last time, with a head second at Hamilton before that. Should be ready to fire third up.
